channels.name: Ali Abdaal
channels.description: Ex-NHS doctor turned entrepreneur, 5M+ subscribers. Not business-of-medicine content itself, but the clearest live case study of a doctor building a business on camera.
channels.verificationMethod: Confirmed via official site aliabdaal.com and multiple independent search results all pointing to the same channel ID. Main channel, not his separate vlog or Lifestyle Business Academy channels.

channels.name: Dr. Una | EntreMD
channels.description: Dr. Nneka Unachukwu, MD — Nigerian-trained physician who coaches other physicians on building 7-figure businesses and using YouTube to grow a practice.
channels.verificationMethod: Fetched channel page directly; self-description explicitly matches 'business of medicine' framing word for word. Cross-confirmed by entremd.com blog/podcast content referencing the same channel.

channels.name: Dr Ola Brown
channels.description: Founder of Flying Doctors Nigeria (West Africa's first air ambulance service) and HealthCap Africa. Now runs #Ecofininsights — finance and economics content from a physician-investor.
channels.verificationMethod: Confirmed via her own Medium post referencing 'my youtube channel', cross-checked against her active X/Twitter account (@NaijaFlyingDr) linking to recent videos on the same channel.

channels.name: The Doctorpreneur Academy
channels.description: Community channel for healthcare professionals, associated with Dr. BB Phetla's Doctorpreneur platform (South Africa) — 13+ years private practice plus an MBA, framed explicitly as 'the business of medicine' for African doctors.
channels.verificationMethod: Channel self-description confirms healthcare-professional business focus, matching the Doctorpreneur/doctorpreneur.co.za branding independently confirmed via podcast interviews (The Dr Coffee Podcast, Medically Inclined). Not 100% confirmed as Dr. Phetla's personally-run channel vs. the wider Doctorpreneur community — flagged for a closer look.

blogs.name: Nairametrics
blogs.verificationMethod: Exact feed URL confirmed via FeedSpot's Nigeria Personal Finance RSS directory. Leading Nigerian business/financial news site; covers healthcare-sector business news as part of its general business coverage rather than a dedicated healthcare-only feed.

blogs.name: White Coat Investor
blogs.verificationMethod: Exact feed URL confirmed via FeedSpot's Top 100 Investment RSS Feeds directory. The most established physician personal-finance blog (since 2011, Dr. James Dahle) — global, not Nigeria-specific, but directly on-topic and extremely well established.

books.title: Starting Private Practice
books.author: Pamela Wible, MD
books.freeSourceNote: Free download directly from the author's site
books.verificationMethod: Confirmed via direct search result: a genuinely free, downloadable guide by a real, credentialed family physician (documented on Wikipedia). Step-by-step guide to launching a private practice, including for professionals without a license to run one independently.
